author: Codex
purpose: Bucket visual reference for Setsuna; SAM remains the Earn flow reference. Research only.
coverageLimits: Public/disconnected states only; no terms accepted, wallet connected or transactions submitted.
External Farm, Documents and Legacy applications were not studied.
Some initial screenshots contain loading placeholders.
D-j-View captured the root SPA but failed offline verification; live route inspections supplement it.

background.method: Pixel samples from Bucket main-bg.png, not named CSS tokens

typography.note: Do not copy the tight heading line-height for wrapping text. PP Writer Italic is a loaded asset, not an observed rendered app face.

motion.cardHover: Tint change; no measured card scaling.

components.name: App shell
components.observed: Full-height dark canvas, 64px header, central navigation, footer metrics.
components.setsuna: Simple header and existing destinations; original ocean CSS gradient.

components.name: Vault cards
components.observed: Two tinted product cards, token marks, brief benefits, large rate and CTA.
components.setsuna: setsMON and setsUSDC cards with current onchain figures.

components.name: Amount form
components.observed: Deposit/Withdraw tabs, amount, balance, asset pill, 25/50/75/Max, estimate disclosure, white CTA.
components.setsuna: Keep shared asset switcher and existing transaction logic; preserve MON gas reserve.

components.name: Token picker
components.observed: Centered dialog, selected-row tint, icon, symbol, full name, address and close control.
components.setsuna: Supported MON/USDC selection; keyboard access and focus restoration.

components.name: Settings
components.observed: Compact slippage dialog with input and preset chips.
components.setsuna: Use the component pattern where a setting actually applies; do not add slippage to pure vault actions without a need.

components.name: Performance
components.observed: APR line chart, gradient fill, dashed average, 7D/30D/90D controls.
components.setsuna: Only recorded share-value/asset history; unavailable data is labelled.

components.name: Allocation/route
components.observed: Compact arrow diagram, key-value metrics, collapsible details.
components.setsuna: Real adapter allocations and explanatory details in quiet panels.

components.name: Market cards/table
components.observed: Category chips, list/grid toggle, token-first headings, subdued row surfaces.
components.setsuna: Apply visual hierarchy to protocol and portfolio data as appropriate.

components.name: Portfolio/history
components.observed: Disconnected connect panel and tabbed history dialog.
components.setsuna: Keep actual position, wallet-balance and accounting data; connected Bucket layout not observed.

components.name: Swap
components.observed: Compact bottom-right desktop drawer with paired amount panels, token pills, direction switch and white action.
components.setsuna: Component inspiration; preserve existing Spot/Perps product flows.

components.name: Mobile navigation
components.observed: Compact header, menu overlay, stacked cards, fixed bottom tabs, almost full-width token dialog.
components.setsuna: Earn/Spot/Perps/Portfolio; reserve bottom spacing and respect safe areas.

components.name: Risk/position controls
components.observed: Borrow/leverage sliders, coloured risk scales, position panels and info disclosures.
components.setsuna: Visual reference only; no added borrowing product implied.

implementationNotes: Keep Setsuna Wave Lift identity and Google Inter.
Recreate surfaces/gradients in maintainable CSS; reference screenshots are not production assets.
Use real Setsuna rates and historical data.
Check contrast, focus visibility, keyboard control and reduced-motion behaviour during implementation.
No application code changes or push performed for this study.
